about: docs.rs is the documentation host for Rust crates. This CLI searches crates, resolves the best match, reads crate pages (build status, builds, features, versions, source files), reads rustdoc pages and item lists, and browses release listings, failures, the build queue and the Atom feed.

commands.summary: Search Rust crates on docs.rs by keyword, optionally sorted by downloads or recency

params.name: query
params.description: Search keywords, e.g. a crate name or topic

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. relevance=Relevance, downloads=All-Time Downloads, recent-downloads=Recent Downloads, recent-updates=Recent Updates, new=Newly Added

params.name: paginate
params.description: Opaque base64 page token taken from the page's 'Next Page' link (/releases/search?paginate=...). When set, it replaces query and sort.

commands.summary: I'm Feeling Lucky: jump to the best-matching crate for a query and return its exact name and latest version
Get a crate's docs.rs overview page: title, description, documentation link and coverage

params.name: name
params.description: Crate name as published on crates.io

params.name: version
params.description: Exact version (e.g. 1.0.229), a semver requirement, or 'latest'

commands.summary: Check whether docs built successfully for a crate version (JSON: doc_status, resolved version)
List the docs build history of a crate version: rustc version, date, duration, memory, result
List the Cargo feature flags of a crate version
List all published versions of a crate with their release dates
List the files and folders in a crate's published source package (root or a subfolder)

params.name: dir
params.description: Folder path ending with '/', e.g. 'src/'. Empty means the package root.

commands.summary: Read the contents of one file in a crate's source package, e.g. Cargo.toml or src/lib.rs

params.name: path
params.description: File path inside the package, e.g. Cargo.toml or src/lib.rs

commands.summary: Read a crate's rustdoc landing page: crate docs text, version, permalink

params.name: crate
params.description: Library name as used in Rust code (dashes become underscores), usually the same as the package name

commands.summary: List every public item (structs, enums, traits, functions, types, constants) of a crate, with links to their doc pages
Read the rustdoc page of one item (struct, trait, fn...) inside a crate

params.name: item_path
params.description: Item page path relative to the crate root, as given by list-crate-items href, e.g. task/struct.JoinHandle.html

commands.summary: Browse docs.rs release listings: recent releases, top crates by GitHub stars, recent build failures, or failures sorted by stars

params.name: kind
params.description: Listing type: recent=newest releases, stars=crates with most stars, recent-failures=latest failed builds, failures=most-starred crates that failed to build

params.name: page
params.description: Page number starting at 1 (30 items per page)

commands.summary: Get the Atom feed of the most recently built crate releases (structured JSON)
List the crate releases waiting in the docs.rs build queue
List the crate docs builds currently running and how long they have been running
